hypotheses.F0_finite_trace_recomposes: Unperturbed suffix execution agrees with native final states to maximum absolute error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.F1_late_hubs_are_causally_persistent: At Layer 10, median same-direction central-response cosine for high-degree canonical hubs is at least 0.90 on every corpus.
hypotheses.F2_midlayer_hubs_are_causally_persistent: At Layer 6, median same-direction central-response cosine for high-degree canonical hubs is at least 0.70 on every corpus.
hypotheses.F3_linear_transport_predicts_large_edits: A transport matrix fit only to small FineWeb edits predicts large canonical-edit final-coordinate deltas with energy fidelity at least 0.80 on every corpus at both depths.
hypotheses.F4_transport_predicts_graph_changes: The same frozen map predicts changes in the selected 32 interaction products with energy fidelity at least 0.70 on every corpus at both depths.
hypotheses.F5_canonical_hubs_are_privileged_carrier: Canonical high-degree hubs exceed matched random subspace directions in median directional cosine by at least 0.10 on every corpus at both depths.
hypotheses.F6_transport_is_stable_across_edit_size: Central responses at the small scale, multiplied by the scale ratio, predict large-scale central responses with energy fidelity at least 0.85 on every corpus at both depths.
